mapper.insert: insert into coupon (title, type, condition_amount, discount_amount, discount_rate, valid_from, valid_to, total, issued, created_at) values (#{title}, #{type}, #{conditionAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{discountRate}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{total}, #{issued}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update:
update user_coupon
status = #{status},
order_id = #{orderId},
used_at = #{usedAt},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, title, condition_amount, discount_amount, discount_rate, valid_to, (total - issued) as remain, issued, type from coupon where valid_to > #{now}
select id, title, condition_amount, discount_amount, discount_rate, valid_to, (total - issued) as remain, issued, type from coupon
select uc.id as userCouponId, uc.user_id, uc.status, uc.received_at, uc.used_at, u.nickname from user_coupon uc left join user u on uc.user_id = u.id where uc.coupon_id = #{couponId}
